route_presets.label: Closure spaces and norm geometry
route_presets.bridge: Begin with hull–kernel closure on the kernel families obtained from faces. Closure need not be topological; finite continuity tests finite subsets, whereas continuity tests every subset.

route_presets.label: Faces, pure states and spectra
route_presets.bridge: Faces and extreme dual functionals lead to pure states and representation components. Unitary-equivalence classes of irreducible representations and their kernels remain different objects; the two spectral comparisons use their respective hull–kernel topologies.

route_presets.label: Normal parts and semilinear structure
route_presets.bridge: Pass from a representation component to its coefficient-kernel normal part with relative closure. Projective parametrization is a bijection. The same map, its inverse, the scalar automorphism and global orientation retain the hypotheses specified in each manuscript; full continuity requires extra conditions.

route_presets.label: The central characterization
route_presets.bridge: The faithful, fully normal representation condition and continuous finite conjugation meet in the elementary-algebra characterization. Retain the same GNS model, equality of the compact-operator image, singleton condition, and two-sided conjugate continuity.

route_presets.label: From components to classification
route_presets.bridge: Use compact comparisons to read representation-theoretic conditions. Compact containment differs from equality; prescribed dimension differs from an upper bound. Transport through a specified homeomorphism retains that specified map.

route_presets.label: Compact representations, decomposition and rigidity
route_presets.bridge: Faithful compact representation leads to the canonical c₀-decomposition indexed by minimal nonzero closed ideals. Its compact-operator summands are distinct from compact operators on a Hilbert direct sum. The final rigidity results assert existence of an isomorphism, with the different model hypotheses below.
